verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner should: quote mark, quote, attribution, SOLSTICE logo, then the can. It keeps the brand logo. Its flaws: the attribution floats far from the quote, at the top centre-right with dead space under it, and the quote text and can are tiny. B gets the hierarchy wrong: the bold gold attribution, pushed into the bottom-left corner, is bigger and louder than the quote and comes before it in reading order. B also drops the SOLSTICE logo and leaves the can as a small, cramped scrap at the right edge.
